correctness.rationale: The scalar Gaussian-mixture convex-order criterion is exactly t≤E R, by Jensen plus |x| test. The regular-simplex frame identifies zero-sum projected vectors, and the sharp norm inequality sum |a_i|≥sqrt(2 sum a_i²) attained on two entries proves projected threshold sqrt[2/d(d+1)]. Any jointly Gaussian rank-one coupling has scalar correlation C PSD diag1; the trace bound tr Cov(mean)=(n²-1^T C 1)/(d n²)≤1/d forces s≤1/d. Correlation C=V^T V attains I/d², and trace equality plus Gram projectors gives rigidity. Verified exact rational Gram, trace, projection identities d=2..10. It does NOT claim that actual multivariate convex order fails.
